scope: Shared replacement for existing Charles River, Maryland ODK fountain, and standalone MIT water materials.

implementation.waves: Analytic multi-scale noise gradients with world-space drift and distance filtering; no repeating bitmap, diagonal stripe field, or vertex displacement.
implementation.reflection: Angle-dependent Fresnel sky response. Desktop standard Charles additionally renders the scene into one 768 x 384 half-float planar reflection, capped at 12 Hz. Desktop low and both mobile tiers allocate no planar reflection target.
implementation.shore: A 256 x 128 single-channel distance field samples the existing open bank polylines. It supplies a restrained near-bank colour and calmer normals, not bathymetric depth.
implementation.mobile: Replaces only the named Charles River water material in the offline GLB. Preserves its sparse geometry, underlying buffers and non-collision flags. The shader shares the live world clock and survives low / HD / low switches.
implementation.otherWater: Maryland's horizontal pool surfaces share the shader; vertical waterfall faces keep their original normals. Standalone MIT retains the name water so its collision exclusion remains valid. The hidden older MIT water in World stays hidden.
implementation.ownership: Campus owns shore field and materials. Reflection owner releases its target on low quality and dispose. Green Line remains runtime-only; the mobile campus rebake shifts platform slabs to the corrected vehicle clearance.

limitations: No swimming, boat physics, screen-space refraction, surveyed underwater terrain, or simulated fluid dynamics.
Mobile uses analytic sky reflection rather than reflected campus geometry.
Existing mobile Maryland/UPenn/Arizona bakes have no pool meshes; this change does not add new water bodies.

validation.note: Reports are generated from the actual loaders/renderers; touch Chromium memory checks do not establish physical iPhone stability.

results.unitTests: 50 files / 256 tests passed with 1–2 workers; the initial high-concurrency run hit an existing 5-second route-test timeout, which passed independently and in the bounded full rerun.
results.water: Initial full desktop Boston / mobile low-HD-low / desktop UMD run: 68 checks, 16 captures, no errors. After increasing the desktop target to 768 x 384 and adding a 5-tap texel-sized filter: targeted desktop rerun 17 checks, 4 captures, no errors. The latter report replaces the initial report; original mobile and UMD image files remain.
results.legacyMit: Three tiers standard / low / standard-again passed through the actual /real/mit page, with shared animated water and no shader error; output/water-green-line/legacy-mit/report.json.
results.greenLine: 27 checks / 8 desktop and mobile views passed; Central camera moved out of the adjacent building before visual acceptance.
results.productionMobile: All 29 BU destinations, directional movement, HD opt-in, reload and map checks passed; no errors.
results.productionDeployment: 8 checks passed: authentication, desktop rendering, alternate avatar, campus travel, persistence, logout and mobile travel; no network failures.
